verdict.rationale: Buzz has scattered audit-adjacent primitives — agents have their own signed-event audit trail (buzz-gh-4), an admin API secured with NIP-98 signed events (buzz-supp-admin-api), and a moderation dashboard showing reports/feedback (buzz-docs-16) — but there is no documented consolidated audit-log view/export covering both admin and general user actions across the workspace for compliance review. missing for 10: a dedicated audit-log feature/UI for reviewing all admin+user actions, log retention/export controls, and any compliance-oriented reporting or independent confirmation it works as described.
